verdict.rationale: Jeeves claims TypeScript and Python SDKs for its payments API (jeeves-docs-17), plus a broader API platform with authentication and webhook docs, but the evidence pack contains no SDK repo links, code samples, package names, or version history, and probes show the OpenAPI/llms.txt discovery endpoints returning 404s, suggesting weak SDK-adjacent documentation infrastructure. Missing for 10: links to actual SDK repositories/packages, code examples using the SDKs, versioning/release notes, and independent corroboration of SDK usability.
